SELECTED SOURCES & FURTHER READING

NIST — The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0. 2024. Risk-management framework for understanding, prioritizing, and communicating cybersecurity outcomes. https://www.nist.gov/publications/nist-cybersecurity-framework-csf-20

CISA — Require Multifactor Authentication. Guidance on MFA and stronger phishing-resistant methods. https://www.cisa.gov/audiences/small-and-medium-businesses/secure-your-business/require-multifactor-authentication
OWASP — LLM01:2025 Prompt Injection. AI security guidance on prompt-injection risks and mitigations. https://genai.owasp.org/llmrisk/llm01-prompt-injection/
OpenAI Help Center — ChatGPT Capabilities Overview. Current overview of conversational AI, search, and tool-supported workflows. Accessed 2026.
Harvard Program on Negotiation — BATNA: Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement. Updated May 27, 2026. https://www.pon.harvard.edu/daily/batna/translate-your-batna-to-the-current-deal/
Microsoft Support — SUMIFS function; Excel functions by category; PivotTable guidance. Current documentation accessed 2026.
Google Docs Editors Help — XLOOKUP. Current Google Sheets documentation accessed 2026.
Kahneman, Daniel — Thinking, Fast and Slow. Farrar, Straus and Giroux, 2011.
Fisher, Roger; Ury, William; Patton, Bruce — Getting to Yes: Negotiating Agreement Without Giving In. 3rd ed., Penguin, 2011.
Simon, Herbert A. — Administrative Behavior and bounded rationality research; useful for understanding decisions under constraints.
Deming, W. Edwards — Out of the Crisis. MIT Press, 1986.
Drucker, Peter F. — The Effective Executive. HarperBusiness, 1967.

EDITORIAL NOTE

This edition was constructed as a practical expansion of the Resourceful Human architecture available in the user’s file library. The preserved core includes the eight worlds/levels, the emphasis on 30% learning and 70% doing, short lessons, missions, simulations, AI challenges, and a final unknown challenge.

Claims about current digital tools and changing security practices have been checked against current official or authoritative web sources where feasible. Timeless ideas are presented as principles; current implementations are deliberately framed as examples rather than permanent dependencies.
The goal is earned confidence: not “I know everything,” but “I know how to approach what I do not know — and I know when the deeper question is what actually matters.”
